title: Roommate Detector
shortDescription: A fun little MicroPython script that uses an ultrasonic sensor to notice a door opening and fire a webhook.
longDescription: Roommate Detector runs on a Wi-Fi capable microcontroller with an ultrasonic distance sensor. It calibrates a baseline distance, watches for readings that drift outside a tolerance several times in a row, and then posts a "door opened probably" message to a webhook.
highlights: Baseline calibration with a tolerance window to filter noise
